five_minutes: India's WPI inflation accelerated to 12.29% in October, dampening expectations for RBI interest rate cuts as input cost pressures re-emerge.
India's current account deficit widened to $7.4 billion in September, adding structural pressure on the rupee and increasing reliance on capital inflows.
CBDT is evaluating LTCG and STT tax modifications ahead of the Union Budget, which could alter equity trading and portfolio tax planning.
Category 2 Hurricane Isaias forced energy infrastructure shut-ins along the US Gulf Coast, keeping Brent crude elevated above $90.
Softening iron ore and copper prices in Australia highlight ongoing weakness in Chinese industrial commodity demand.

theses.thesis: Crypto is rising because markets expect a global recession (crypto trading as the recession hedge)
US policy decisions under Trump are pushing the US economy toward decline, contrary to the stated growth narrative
Gold and silver will NOT rise further even in a recession, because they are already at all-time highs
Nifty 29-Sep futures will fall below 23,000 before expiry

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: Production shut-ins as Hurricane Isaias nears Gulf Coast landfall bolster crude supply risk and keep Brent elevated
items.what_happened: The Energy Information Administration reported that Category 2 Hurricane Isaias is nearing Gulf Coast landfall, forcing energy infrastructure shut-ins ahead of impact.
items.why_it_matters: Disruptions to US Gulf Coast oil infrastructure tighten global crude availability, maintaining upward pressure on Brent crude above $90 and expanding India's import bill.

items.headline: Weakening industrial metal prices signal softening China commodity demand and weigh on resource equities
items.what_happened: Australian equity benchmarks fell to a near one-week low as tumbling copper and iron ore prices dragged down mining heavyweights.
items.why_it_matters: Softening bulk commodity prices reflect sluggish Chinese real estate and industrial activity, mitigating global input inflation while signalling persistent weakness in Asian economic momentum.

items.headline: Upcoming Xi-Trump-Putin summit creates headline risks for trade policy and global energy flows
items.what_happened: China officially confirmed preparations for a trilateral summit featuring Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin.
items.why_it_matters: Trilateral engagement among major global powers introduces tail risks for tariff policy, sanctions enforcement, and global energy market supply agreements.

items.headline: Accelerated WPI inflation to 12.29% signals persistent input cost pressure across Indian manufacturing
items.what_happened: India's wholesale price inflation accelerated to 12.29% year-on-year in October, exceeding market expectations.
items.why_it_matters: High wholesale price pressure threatens corporate margin compression across industrial and consumer sectors, reducing room for RBI monetary easing despite slowing growth.

items.headline: Expanding current account deficit to $7.4 billion intensifies underlying depreciation pressure on the rupee
items.what_happened: RBI data shows India's current account deficit widened to $7.4 billion in September 2026 from $5.2 billion a year earlier, driving the H1 deficit up to $25.8 billion.
items.why_it_matters: A widening trade and current account deficit increases India's reliance on capital flows, leaving the rupee vulnerable to foreign portfolio outflows and compelling ongoing RBI reserve intervention.

items.headline: Cancellation of 49 NBFC registrations highlights RBI's continued regulatory purge of non-compliant shadow banks
items.what_happened: The RBI cancelled the Certificate of Registration of 49 Non-Banking Financial Companies under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act.
items.why_it_matters: Continued regulatory housecleaning reinforces strict capital and governance norms across the NBFC space, filtering out inactive entities while raising compliance standards for operating non-bank lenders.

items.headline: RBI successfully switches ₹21,000 crore of short-dated debt to push maturities out to 2034-2062
items.what_happened: The RBI conducted a switch auction converting short-term Government of India securities maturing between 2027 and 2029 into longer-dated paper maturing between 2034 and 2062.
items.why_it_matters: Active debt management reduces near-term redemption pressure for the sovereign, smoothing the government bond supply profile and supporting long-end G-sec yields.

items.headline: Electronics manufacturing sell-off highlights margin vulnerabilities across Indian EMS and component suppliers
items.what_happened: Amber Enterprises fell 8.4% after peer Kaynes Technology reported weaker-than-expected Q2 financial results, dragging down sentiment across the sector.
items.why_it_matters: Softness in component and EMS earnings challenges high growth valuations in the domestic electronics manufacturing theme, underscoring rising input costs and client destocking.

items.headline: Global aerospace supply chain diversification drives sharp outperformance in Indian precision component suppliers
items.what_happened: Ten Indian aerospace suppliers, including Sansera Engineering and Aequs, have surged an average of 123% this year as Airbus and Boeing shift sourcing to India.
items.why_it_matters: Structural OEM supply chain diversification away from traditional hubs provides multi-year revenue visibility for specialized Indian engineering exporters, bucking the broader 3% decline in the Nifty 50.

items.headline: Upcoming ₹23,000 crore T-Bill issuance tests short-end liquidity amid tight banking system conditions
items.what_happened: The RBI scheduled auctions for 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day Treasury Bills totalling ₹23,000 crore on November 18.
items.why_it_matters: Regular T-bill supply absorbs short-term institutional cash, setting benchmark yields for commercial paper and short-term corporate debt instruments.

items.headline: Potential LTCG and STT revisions in the upcoming Budget could reshape capital gains tax burdens for equity investors
items.what_happened: CBDT Chairman Ravi Agrawal confirmed the government is examining industry proposals to modify long-term capital gains (LTCG) and Securities Transaction Tax (STT) ahead of the Union Budget.
items.why_it_matters: Any changes to equity capital gains taxation or transaction taxes directly impact net portfolio returns and require you to re-evaluate tax-harvesting strategies for domestic equity clients.
items.action: Review client capital gains harvesting options ahead of Union Budget proposals.

items.headline: Decentralised FEMA compounding delegated to RBI regional offices speeds up cross-border compliance resolution
items.what_happened: The RBI delegated compounding powers for select contraventions under the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), 1999, to its regional offices.
items.why_it_matters: Localised compounding authority reduces turnaround times for resolving technical FEMA non-compliance, simplifying cross-border corporate reporting and advisory workflows for CAs.
items.action: Check client FDI and ODI compounding applications pending with RBI to route or re-submit via regional offices if eligible.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: Tax authority concerns over inverted duty structures stall GST rate cuts on air purifiers and filtration equipment
items.what_happened: Tax officials rejected lowering GST rates on air purifiers and HEPA filters, citing concerns that lower output duties relative to input taxes would create inverted duty structure claims.
items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the GST Council's policy constraint where inverted tax structures create refund liabilities, keeping effective tax rates elevated on consumer health hardware.
